core_rule: No implementation, modification, evaluation, or milestone transition may begin until the latest project state, canonical source, handoff, integration contract, measured results, and roadmap have been actually read and their hashes verified.
on_failure: STOP. Restore from canonical archive or Google Drive; otherwise report the missing or inconsistent item to the user. Never infer missing implementation details.

receipt_freshness.rule: Newest receipt must match current Git HEAD and PROJECT_STATE. Preflight receipts bind work to the current milestone; transition receipts authorize one declared promotion commit and then become stale.

p1_specific_guard.rule: P1 tissue may access the body only through the frozen P0 port and must be compared with an equal-material equal-maintenance non-informational dummy.
